description: This Java class is a final, immutable factory for creating EnforcementFilter instances, parametrized with generic types I and M. It implements the EnforcementFilterFactory interface and constructs EnforcementFilter objects based on enforcement configurations and placeholders, resolving input values through PlaceholderFilter and PlaceholderFactory.
